name: Goflow
summary: Multichannel e-commerce operations: orders, inventory, listings and shipping across all your marketplaces in one dashboard. Goflow Core is free forever (500 orders, 3 users) and automates Amazon MCF fulfilment for TikTok Shop orders; the vendor states eligible orders may qualify for 35% savings on Amazon MCF rates (vendor mail, 27 Jul 2026). Goflow lists 250+ integrations across marketplaces, shipping, 3PL and accounting (goflow.com, 12 Aug 2026), and a nocnoc integration keeps Latin American listings, inventory, orders and fulfilment in sync from inside Goflow (vendor mail, 5 Aug 2026).
best_for: multichannel e-commerce operations with serious order volume that want orders, inventory, purchasing, listings and shipping unified — including EDI retail
skip_if: you sell on one channel only (a single-channel tool costs a tenth), or your volume sits just past the free Core allowance but nowhere near what the $499/mo entry plan is worth
honest_knock: Core is free forever but no longer the whole platform: it connects only Amazon, eBay, Shopify, TikTok and Walmart, has no API or App Store, syncs with QuickBooks Online only, and stops importing at 500 orders until the 1st of the next month. The next step up is $499/mo for 750 orders, and Goflow states you cannot move back down to Core once you go paid. Budget the EDI setup separately: $500-1,300 one-time per connection, multiplied by the number of retail partners.

pricing.entry_price_terms: entry plan (750 orders) · per month for 750 orders, month-to-month
pricing.notes: (re-verified 23 Sep 2026 on goflow.com/pricing; the plan ladder was restructured since 3 Sep) Goflow Core is free forever at $0/mo with no credit card, capped at 500 orders a month (new orders then wait until the 1st of the next month or an upgrade), 3 users and 1,000 newly created listings, and limited to stores on Amazon, eBay, Shopify, TikTok and Walmart, QuickBooks Online only, with no API and no App Store. Paid subscriptions are priced by typical monthly order volume through a calculator on the page; its plan data lists $499 for 750 orders, $789 for 2,500, $1,149 for 5,000, $1,449 for 10,000 plus 100 wholesale, $2,249 for 25,000, $2,999 for 50,000 and $4,599 for 100,000, each with a wholesale-weighted twin at the same price that trades retail orders for wholesale ones ($1,149 buys 5,000 retail orders or 2,000 plus 100 wholesale). The $499 and $789 plans include no wholesale orders. Overage per additional order runs from $0.70 on the $499 plan through $0.50 and $0.30 down to $0.10, and from $8 down to $3 per wholesale order. On 3 September the page showed named tiers instead, Launch $499 (750 orders) and Scale $979 (5,000 orders plus wholesale); no $979 plan exists in the current data. Every paid plan is month-to-month, billed on the 1st, with no setup or implementation fees; Enterprise is shown as "Let's talk" and is the one 12-month commitment. EDI, SFTP and AS2 connections carry a one-time setup and testing fee of typically $500-1,300 per connection, and custom document or label design is billed hourly. Channel-fulfilled orders count at half weight. There is no free trial and no discount programme — the free Core plan is the trial (vendor mail, 12 Aug 2026).

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 24 October 2026 on the free Core plan: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We imported two made-up products, exported them and updated them again by Item Number.
findings: After sign-up Goflow opened on a setup checklist that can be skipped; we saw no card, call or integration requirement.

Products > Import Products (Create Standard Products) took our CSV with Item Number, Name, Description and Price and imported both products. Prices appeared in dollars although our test file used euros, and a line break in a description became a space.
Export Products from the products list gave a CSV with both Item Numbers, the Unicode names and unchanged numeric prices, but no currency or internal-ID column.

Re-importing by Item Number updated the two existing products without creating duplicates: only the second description changed, and its line break again became a space. A re-import by Goflow's own internal ID is not offered.
We found no billing, subscription or plan page in the app, so there was no checkout to compare with the free Core plan.
Adding a user under Users > New User asks the administrator to set that user's password; we did not create one.
not_tested: The registration screens (Daan created the account)
